name: Art Deco
summary: A 1930s poster that moves: gold engraved keylines on warm lacquer black, airbrushed hard-edged volumes, one sacred centre axis, and light arriving bulb by bulb.

palette.use: warm black ground of every frame; never neutral grey-black
lacquer: plaques (at 88 %), door leaves, the engraved underline of every gold line
gold base: eyebrows, labels, dial numerals, the mid band of the metal gradient
gold shadow: dark band of the metal gradient, unlit bulbs
burgundy: the hero of the frame only, the one large saturated area
jewel emerald: arch fills, fish scales, doors, secondary surfaces; never competes in area with the hero
light band of the metal gradient, sunburst wedges
hot band, hairline highlight, lit bulb cores
the one-colour exception: one element in its own colour, when the story needs that colour named (blue light in the samples)
night sky at the top of a sky ground

banned: a gold-foil slideshow: things must move and have volume
Art Nouveau whiplash curves or flowers
a flat vector poster: volumes are airbrushed and rimmed
anything drifting off the centre axis
copying a real poster layout, building, character or typeface design
